messages:
nina: Quick heads up — pen test scheduled Wed 2025-03-27 09:00 PT. Assessor asked for ephemeral RBAC to view audit logs + KMS key usage. Can we confirm access window and evidence export flow?

alex: How wide is 'view'? Do they need console UI or just log/metrics dumps?

priya: Prefer log dumps + presigned artifacts. No console access. We should only grant least-privilege read to CloudTrail + S3 logs + KMS:Describe/GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext for usage metadata.

lila (sec-eng): Agree — no Decrypt. We can create an ephemeral role with scoped permissions and session duration 4h. Also add KMS CloudWatch Events + CloudTrail lookups.

sam (oncall): Are we doing evidence export via presigned S3 links or encrypted bundles? Need to ensure chain-of-custody.

nina: Assessor prefers an S3 bundle. We'll pre-generate a manifest and presign an object that they'll pull. Question: do we need to rotate the KMS CMK alias before/after?

priya: No rotation required. We'll create a one-time data key for envelope encryption, use KMS:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext, encrypt the bundle client-side, upload, then presign. KMS access is only to generate data key metadata.

lila (sec-eng): Also require audit logging retention snapshot. We'll export CloudTrail to a separate bucket with enforced object lock for the window.

alex: IAM policy prototype:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["cloudtrail:LookupEvents","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"*"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345"}
  ]
}
```

sam (oncall): Can someone link the remediation tracker? We'll want to map any findings to JIRA and reserve retest slots.

nina: I'll create JIRA PT-978 and assign triage. Proposed retest windows: Mon/Thu following initial report. Who owns retest coordination?

lila (sec-eng): I'll own retest scheduling and evidence validation. Action items:
• nina: create JIRA + add assessor contact
• priya: build ephemeral role + policy + presign playbook
• alex: set up export bucket + object-lock
• sam: confirm oncall coverage during window

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: ephemeral-role creation job queued for 2025-03-25 18:00 UTC

nina: Thanks — looped in @security-leads and support. We'll reconvene Mon 03/24 for a final dry-run. :thumbsup:
